title: RoleRequirement
description: A recruiter's explicit, evidence-based requirements for one role. Owned by the HR portal. Sent to Trust only to choose which consented evidence to return (competencies and recipient); coverage and gaps are computed by the HR portal. It can express competency evidence only: no ranking weights, no speed or time proxies, no personal attributes. DRAFT 0.1.

recipient_id.description: The recruiter organisation. Must match the recipient on any ShareGrant used.

version.description: Increments on every change so past matches stay reproducible.

priority.description: A missing required competency is shown as a gap. It is never turned into a rank.

min_levels_passed.description: Highest ladder level that must be passed.

min_estimate_lower.description: Threshold applied to the lower edge of the estimate band, so uncertainty counts against the candidate only when evidence is thin.

max_evidence_age_days.description: Recency window for the most recent evidence.

allowed_methods.description: Optional. Restricts which evidence methods count toward this competency.
